bey.name: Trypio
bey.description: An absolute classic from the early generations. Trypio features a massive, distinctive outer propeller ring designed to catch updrafts and alter air currents inside the stadium, turning raw wind into survival energy.

ability.description: Trypio's massive propeller layer generates constant lift. Reduces all incoming impact damage by 25, converts friction into stability, and recovers 1 Stamina per turn passively.
